institution: DIGITECH FP (centro oficial de Formación Profesional, online) — PROVIDER TYPE: FP CENTRE MARKETING A 'MÁSTER'
programme_name: Máster FP Online en Python (desarrollo de aplicaciones con Python)
official_status: OFFICIAL IN THE FP REGISTER, NOT A UNIVERSITY MASTER. Spanish law calls this a Curso de Especialización de Formación Profesional; 'Máster de FP' is marketing shorthand. It is NOT a máster universitario, is NOT in RUCT, sits at MECES level 5 (higher VET) not level 7, and gives no PhD access and no access to university-master funding.
start_date_verbatim: «Convocatoria febrero 2026» — «el lanzamiento del nuevo Ciclo Superior en Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Web (DAW)» y «la apertura del Máster FP Online en Python». «Iniciar en febrero significa ganar medio año.»
intakes_per_year: 2 implied (February and September) — the page contrasts a February start with September but does not state 'dos convocatorias' in so many words, so 2 is recorded as IMPLIED, not verbatim
modality: Online / a distancia — «el único centro oficial de FP que imparte esta formación a distancia en España»
tuition_total_eur: NOT FOUND
evidence_verbatim: Convocatoria febrero 2026 … la apertura del Máster FP Online en Python … formación oficial y pionera que solo DIGITECH imparte en esta modalidad en España … el único centro oficial de FP que imparte esta formación a distancia en España … 430h, aproximadamente 4 meses … Iniciar en febrero significa ganar medio año.
notes: EXACTLY THE PROVIDER TYPE THE PROMPT ASKED ME TO SURFACE: an FP centre advertising a 'máster' with a February convocatoria. The February start is GENUINE (the page contrasts it with waiting for September). BUT IT IS THE WRONG QUALIFICATION FOR THIS CANDIDATE, for two independent reasons: (1) entry is aimed at «titulados en ASIR, DAM o DAW» — Spanish FP higher-technician holders — not at a 300-ECTS engineering graduate, for whom this would be a step DOWN in level, not sideways; (2) at 430 hours / 4 months and MECES level 5 it cannot substitute for a máster universitario and would not support a postgraduate route. RECORDED AS A WARNING AS MUCH AS A FIND: the whole FP sector runs September/February double convocatorias, so a keyword sweep for 'máster inicio febrero' returns a large volume of FP results that look like master's programmes and are not. Cesur FP and UNIVERSAE surfaced in the same search with the same September/February pattern and were not pursued for the same reason.
